## Verification run in this slice, in the foreground

**The gate, before the first source commit** — `tools/check.sh --part k/4`, four bounded
foreground calls, **all four green**: 288 / 287 / 288 / 287 steps, none red
(503 s / 420 s / 318 s / 391 s). No step stood on a banked reading — numpy, scipy,
Pillow, pyproj, jsonschema, openpyxl and pypdf are all installed on this runner, and the
only "not installed" lines in the transcripts are the tagged self-test proving that
warning fires. Preflight's other two questions answered separately (`check.sh` whole does
not fit the 600 s ceiling): `check-changelog-entry.mjs` against merge base `75cd3593` —
entry present; `resolve_id_collisions.mjs --check` — not applicable, tickets are their own
repo.

**Native build** — pinned Blender 4.5.3 on Ubuntu 26.04.1, tarball sha256 verified against
`generators/blender.pin` before use. 82 log_dwelling masters in four bounded batches
(2.7 / 2.8 / 2.7 / 2.7 s), `stale_derivatives.py` → `web_derivatives.sh --only` (18.3 s),
`compile_scene.py --all`, `generate_entrances.py`, `publish.sh` (71 s). **81 of 82 masters
byte-identical**; one moved, Cobweb's, with its one derivative. Hashes in the PR body.

**Smoke, by the parts that cover the diff** (`smoke_budget.mjs --for-diff`), each a bounded
foreground call redirected to a file:

| leg | result |
|---|---|
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=3-4 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 139 passed, 0 failed, 7 m 22 s |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=desktop SMOKE_STAGE=3 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 107 passed, 0 failed, 7 m 16 s |

Stage 3 is the leg `--for-diff` names for the record's own account on the card, the source
sidecars and the liberties — the parts of this diff that are not the mesh itself. Zero page
errors on both.

**Application review, both release viewports, published mirror, default 1835.** I drove the
published tree and looked at the pixels myself, standing on the bank in front of the house:

- **desktop 1280×800 dpr 1** — the centre gable carries TWO upright dark apertures standing
  on the ground, in sawn casings with their reveals, and ONE small dark mark up in the
  gable. The old centred door is gone. Both wings keep their single window; the two
  outer-wing stacks, the roofs and the massing are unchanged. The HUD names the building
  (`Indian Agency House · 30 ft`) and the grounded entrance reads on the front.
- **phone 390×780 dpr 2** — the same three marks, the same two wing windows, the same
  massing.
- **Zero page errors, zero console errors, zero failed or ≥400 requests, zero server 404s**
  at both viewports.

That arrangement is what the panorama draws: the two lower marks in the face's left and
middle with the right-hand stretch left blank, and the upper mark a little left of the
apex.

**What this is not.** The camera on that panorama is still UNSOLVED and is not enrolled in
`data/reference_views/`; no `matches` verdict, no grade change, no completion. The
compound's width, the wings and sub-roofs, the roof junctions, the clapboarding and the
finish still differ. T-2374 stays open and is released back to the queue with those
differences recorded.

resume: foreground gate green (check.sh parts 1-4, mobile 3-4 + desktop 3 smoke, both-viewport app review, zero errors) and dev merged in; hosted gate part 7/8 was still QUEUED after two full 540s pr-automerge laps, so the merge is handed on rather than forced · waits on: nothing

This pull request is the loop's own unfinished work, and it is NOT parked.
The run that opened it could not finish inside its own budget; the branch
carries the work. A later run picks it up before it takes new queue work:
merge `dev` in, re-derive, fix what is red, gate, merge.

`hold` is the owner's park switch and no run applies it — see
`chicago/4d/AGENTS.md` § the two labels.

The face at 9.004 m is behind log skin at 9.022 m; the surround already accounts for skin and its reveal back is 9.026 m.

Use `w.skin + APERTURE_BACK_M` in that local face call, then genuinely rebuild and qualify the affected native defaults and rerender at the unchanged private camera before merge. No shared-helper, camera or grade change is needed. Keep the original partial/DIFFERS status and publish the working repair as an UNQUALIFIED raw source/log/hash checkpoint before long gates. This review does not claim that the proposed repair has run or passed.
